lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to make something happen when two characters touch (bump), and use bumps in game rules.
The yellow “start on bump” block runs when another character touches this one.
An apple can hide when the hero bumps it — collected!
A monster can make the hero shrink when they bump.
Bumps make rules: good bumps and bad bumps.
Bump into each apple (gem) and collect it, then grow from eating!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
